basic_info.description:
Available for 16 months starting July 1, 2022. No roommate situations or businesses. Seeking a family. Not interested in renting out only the cottage. 

Furnished (or unfurnished if preferred) 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath with 1 bedroom, 1 bath cottage. The house has all the amenities. Ideally located within 3 block radius of 7 coffee shops. 2-3 blocks from shopping and restaurants on Polk and Union. 3+ car parking, yard, sandbox, basketball hoop, trampoline, kids fort, big yard, etc. The property is on three city lots. Built in 1875, the house is a SF Landmark listed on the National Historic Register. 

1st Floor: Guest bedroom (queen bed and sofa bed) and guest bathroom, laundry, mudroom, workshop
2nd Floor: Kitchen, living room, dining room, parlor, half bath
3rd floor: Master bedroom (king bed) & bathroom, 3 kids rooms (two full beds and one room with two twin beds), one bathroom
4th floor: Billiard room (75" TV, ping pong table, pool table), office with sofa bed, bathroom
Cottage : Bedroom, bathroom, full kitchen, pull-out sofa bed
Outdoor Space: Trampoline, basketball hoop, sand box.

When requesting a tour, please give some background and explain why our home is a good fit for your family.

12-16 month rental. Utilities (electrical, water, gas, garbage, internet, cable, alarm) paid by tenant. Landscaping paid by landlord.
